proposed_requirement: Motion shall require deliberate valid manual commands and startup neutral permissives
safe_state_or_acceptance_intent: No automatic movement at powerup reset restoration or mode change
independence_or_design_constraint: No autonomy status may serve as manual command permission
verification_method: Software requirement tests bench fault injection later system validation

proposed_requirement: Protective actuation shall independently remove or inhibit hazardous traction torque as determined by hazards
safe_state_or_acceptance_intent: Required stop and controlled response across load slope and drive states
independence_or_design_constraint: Protective path independent of application and autonomy computing
verification_method: Architecture review timed fault injection stopping tests

proposed_requirement: Define and validate service parking emergency stopping and holding performance

independence_or_design_constraint: Regeneration shall not be sole required holding protection

proposed_requirement: Single traction channel fault shall not cause unacceptable steer or loss of stop

proposed_requirement: Lift and tilt shall have engineered retention and controlled movement on defined faults

safe_state_or_acceptance_intent: Attachment and load center defined no excessive deflection instability or overload
independence_or_design_constraint: No ROC release based only on cylinder force target
verification_method: Load case analysis stability validation structural proof

proposed_requirement: Attachment retention shall be positive wear tolerant and safely indicated
safe_state_or_acceptance_intent: No release under defined dynamic electrical control faults; partial engagement detectable as required
independence_or_design_constraint: Loss of electrical signal must not command release

proposed_requirement: ROPS FOPS applicability and protection performance shall be resolved before occupied trials

proposed_requirement: Operator restraint access controls visibility and escape shall support safe manual use
